<!-- Navbar scroll shadow + Scroll animations -->
<script>
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
  // Navbar scroll shadow
  var nb = document.querySelector('.navbar');
  if (nb) {
    window.addEventListener('scroll', function() {
      nb.classList.toggle('scrolled', window.scrollY > 10);
    });
  }

  // Scroll fade-in animations
  var targets = document.querySelectorAll('.home-section, .feat-card, .cv-item, .ra-card, .tl-item, .pub-card');
  targets.forEach(function(el) { el.classList.add('fade-in'); });

  var observer = new IntersectionObserver(function(entries) {
    entries.forEach(function(entry) {
      if (entry.isIntersecting) {
        entry.target.classList.add('visible');
        observer.unobserve(entry.target);
      }
    });
  }, { threshold: 0.08 });

  targets.forEach(function(el) { observer.observe(el); });

  // Inject mini fieldwork gallery into footer (all pages)
  var footer = document.querySelector('.nav-footer .quarto-secondary-nav, .nav-footer .nav-footer-center, .nav-footer');
  var footerEl = document.querySelector('.nav-footer');
  if (footerEl && !document.querySelector('.footer-gallery')) {
    var imgs = ['a1.jpg','a13.jpeg','a30.jpeg','a18.jpeg'];
    var gal = document.createElement('div');
    gal.className = 'footer-gallery';
    var inner = '<span class="footer-gallery-label">From the field</span><div class="footer-gallery-imgs">';
    imgs.forEach(function(im){
      inner += '<a href="speakers.html"><img src="files/images/fieldwork/'+im+'" loading="lazy" alt="Fieldwork"></a>';
    });
    inner += '</div>';
    gal.innerHTML = inner;
    footerEl.parentNode.insertBefore(gal, footerEl);
  }
});
</script>
